correctness.rationale: The explicit X,Y cover has connected crown-graph intersection, and the integral Mayer-Vietoris sequence gives the exact modules in separated degrees n>=5. The ordered-connecting-map swap sign is reconstructed and cancels graph edge reversal. Rational Specht kernels and signed edge/vertex traces are derived; independent signed Lefschetz comparisons passed all 1690 selected graph automorphisms in n=5,6,7, with exact mod-two Betti checks at n=5,6. Finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This supplies a uniform natural integral action for every n>=5 in a graph family with two distinct nonzero homology dimensions. The layer-exchange involution has nontrivial symmetric/skew actions invisible to Betti numbers, the row-column-zero lattice is a concrete reusable integral model, and the complete character determines fixed-action traces for every graph automorphism. These are substantive equivariant invariants rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
